```{ojs}
Res_Elv = (await FileAttachment("Pages/Reservoirs/Data/Reservoir_Elevation.csv").csv()).map(d => ({
  ...d,
  Date: new Date(d.Date + "T00:00:00")
}))
render_date = d3.max(Res_Elv, d => d.Date).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
  month: "long",
  day: "numeric",
  year: "numeric"
})
```

# Major Systems Current Condition

Click here to view interactive charts for each reservoir and total system storage  
[Reservoir Data Dashboard](./Pages/Reservoirs/Reservoir%20Overview.qmd)  

Click here to learn more about basin water use  
[State Usage](./Pages/States/State%20Overview.qmd)  
:::

```{=html}
<link href="https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@4.1.2/dist/maplibre-gl.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@4.1.2/dist/maplibre-gl.js"></script>

<div id="basin-map" style="width:100%; height:700px; border-radius:8px;"></div>

<script>
async function init_map() {

  // ── Load all GeoJSON files ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [upper_basin, lower_basin, reservoirs, rivers] = await Promise.all([
    fetch("GIS_Data/UpperBasin_HUC2.geojson").then(r => r.json()),
    fetch("GIS_Data/LowerBasin_HUC2.geojson").then(r => r.json()),
    fetch("GIS_Data/Reservoirs.geojson").then(r => r.json()),
    fetch("GIS_Data/HydroSheds_Rivers.geojson").then(r => r.json())
  ])

  // ── Initialize map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const map = new maplibregl.Map({
    container: "basin-map",
    style: {
      version: 8,
      sources: {
        "satellite": {
          type: "raster",
          tiles: [
            "https://mt0.google.com/vt/lyrs=s&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}",
            "https://mt1.google.com/vt/lyrs=s&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}",
            "https://mt2.google.com/vt/lyrs=s&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}",
            "https://mt3.google.com/vt/lyrs=s&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}",
          ],
          tileSize: 256,
        },
        // ── Elevation data ──────────────────────────
        "terrarium": {
          type: "raster-dem",
          tiles: ["https://s3.amazonaws.com/elevation-tiles-prod/terrarium/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"],
          tileSize: 256,
          encoding: "terrarium",
        },
      },
      layers: [{ id: "satellite", type: "raster", source: "satellite" }],
      // ── Enable 3D terrain from elevation source ──
      terrain: { source: "terrarium", exaggeration: 2 },
    },
    center:    [-112, 36.5],
    zoom:      5
  })

  map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl(), "top-right")
  map.addControl(new maplibregl.ScaleControl(), "bottom-left")

  map.on("load", () => {

    // ── Upper Basin ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    map.addSource("upper-basin", { type: "geojson", data: upper_basin })
    map.addLayer({ id: "upper-basin-fill",    type: "fill",   source: "upper-basin", paint: { "fill-color": "#5bc0de", "fill-opacity": 0.3 } })
    map.addLayer({ id: "upper-basin-outline", type: "line",   source: "upper-basin", paint: { "line-color": "#1a6496", "line-width": 2 } })

    // ── Lower Basin ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    map.addSource("lower-basin", { type: "geojson", data: lower_basin })
    map.addLayer({ id: "lower-basin-fill",    type: "fill",   source: "lower-basin", paint: { "fill-color": "#5B7EDE", "fill-opacity": 0.3 } })
    map.addLayer({ id: "lower-basin-outline", type: "line",   source: "lower-basin", paint: { "line-color": "#5B7EDE", "line-width": 2 } })

    // ── Rivers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    map.addSource("rivers", { type: "geojson", data: rivers,
      attribution: '<a href="https://www.hydrosheds.org/products/hydrorivers" target="_blank">HydroSheds</a>' })
    map.addLayer({
      id:     "rivers-line",
      type:   "line",
      source: "rivers",
      layout: {
        "line-join": "round",
        "line-cap": "round"
      },
      paint: {
        "line-color": [
          "interpolate",
          ["linear"],
          ["get", "DIS_AV_CMS"],
          0,    "#7bbbf7",   // light blue - low flow
          500,  "#4292c6",   // medium blue
          2000, "#054aa5"    // dark blue - high flow
        ],
        "line-width": [
          "interpolate",
          ["linear"],
          ["get", "DIS_AV_CMS"],
          1,    1,
          550,  12
        ],
        "line-opacity": 0.85
      }
    })

    // ── Reservoirs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    map.addSource("reservoirs", { type: "geojson", data: reservoirs, attribution: '<a href="https://data.usbr.gov/catalog" target="_blank">USBR</a>' })
    map.addLayer({
      id:     "reservoirs-circle",
      type:   "circle",
      source: "reservoirs",
      paint: {
        "circle-color": [
          "step", ["get", "Percent_Full_MAF"],
          "#dc3545", 30, "#fd7e14", 50, "#ffc107", 70, "#198754"
        ],
        "circle-radius":       ["+", 3, ["*", 4, ["sqrt", ["max", ["get", "Max_Capacity_MAF"], 0]]]],
        "circle-stroke-color": "white",
        "circle-stroke-width": 2,
        "circle-opacity":      0.9
      }
    })

    // Popup debug
    map.on("click", "reservoirs-circle", (e) => {
      console.log("Feature properties:", e.features[0].properties)
      })

    // ── Popups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    map.on("click", "reservoirs-circle", (e) => {
      const p   = e.features[0].properties
      const val = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "null" || v === "") ? "N/A" : v

      // Build popup using createElement to avoid Quarto markdown processing
      const container = document.createElement("div")
      container.style.cssText = "width:380px; font-family:sans-serif;"

      container.innerHTML = [
        `<b style="font-size:14px;">${val(p.Reservoir)}: ${val(p.Date)}</b>`,
        `<hr style="margin:6px 0; border-color:#dee2e6;">`,
        `<div style="display:flex; gap:16px;">`,

          // Elevation column
          `<div style="flex:1;">`,
            `<div style="font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:steelblue; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:6px;">Elevation</div>`,
            `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; font-size:12px;">`,
              `<span style="color:#6c757d;">Current</span>`,
              `<span style="font-weight:600;">${val(p.Elevation)} ft</span>`,
            `</div>`,
            `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; font-size:12px;">`,
              `<span style="color:#6c757d;">1yr Ago</span>`,
              `<span style="font-weight:600;">${val(p.Elv_1yr_Ago)} ft</span>`,
            `</div>`,
            `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; font-size:12px;">`,
              `<span style="color:#6c757d;">10yr Avg</span>`,
              `<span style="font-weight:600;">${val(p.Elv_Day_Avg_10yr)} ft</span>`,
            `</div>`,
            `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 0; font-size:12px;">`,
              `<span style="color:#6c757d;">30yr Avg</span>`,
              `<span style="font-weight:600;">${val(p.Elv_Day_Avg_30yr)} ft</span>`,
            `</div>`,
          `</div>`,

          // Divider
          `<div style="width:1px; background:#dee2e6;"></div>`,

          // Storage column
          `<div style="flex:1;">`,
            `<div style="font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:steelblue; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:6px;">Storage</div>`,
            `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; font-size:12px;">`,
              `<span style="color:#6c757d;">Current</span>`,
              `<span style="font-weight:600;">${val(p.Storage_MAF)} MAF | ${val(p.Percent_Full_MAF)}%</span>`,
            `</div>`,
            `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; font-size:12px;">`,
              `<span style="color:#6c757d;">1yr Ago</span>`,
              `<span style="font-weight:600;">${val(p.StorMAF_1yr_Ago)} MAF</span>`,
            `</div>`,
            `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; font-size:12px;">`,
              `<span style="color:#6c757d;">10yr Avg</span>`,
              `<span style="font-weight:600;">${val(p.Stor_Day_Avg_10yr)} MAF</span>`,
            `</div>`,
            `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 0; font-size:12px;">`,
              `<span style="color:#6c757d;">30yr Avg</span>`,
              `<span style="font-weight:600;">${val(p.Stor_Day_Avg_30yr)} MAF</span>`,
            `</div>`,
          `</div>`,

        `</div>`
      ].join("")

      new maplibregl.Popup({ maxWidth: "420px" })
        .setLngLat(e.lngLat)
        .setDOMContent(container)   // use setDOMContent instead of setHTML
        .addTo(map)
    })

    map.on("mouseenter", "reservoirs-circle", () => map.getCanvas().style.cursor = "pointer")
    map.on("mouseleave", "reservoirs-circle", () => map.getCanvas().style.cursor = "")

    // ── Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const legend = document.createElement("div")
    legend.style.cssText = `
      position:absolute; bottom:40px; left:10px; background:white;
      padding:10px 14px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid #dee2e6;
      font-size:12px; font-family:sans-serif; box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); z-index:1;
    `
    legend.innerHTML = `
      <b style="font-size:13px;">% of Capacity</b>
      <div style="margin-top:8px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px;">
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;"><div style="width:14px; height:14px; background:#198754; border-radius:50%;"></div><span>Above 70%</span></div>
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;"><div style="width:14px; height:14px; background:#ffc107; border-radius:50%;"></div><span>50% - 70%</span></div>
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;"><div style="width:14px; height:14px; background:#fd7e14; border-radius:50%;"></div><span>30% - 50%</span></div>
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;"><div style="width:14px; height:14px; background:#dc3545; border-radius:50%;"></div><span>Below 30%</span></div>
      </div>
    `
    document.getElementById("basin-map").appendChild(legend)

    // ── Layer toggles ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const toggle = document.createElement("div")
    toggle.style.cssText = `
      position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; background:white;
      padding:10px 14px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid #dee2e6;
      font-size:12px; font-family:sans-serif; box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); z-index:1;
    `
    toggle.innerHTML = "<b style='font-size:13px;'>Layers</b>"

    const layers = [
      { label: "Upper Basin", ids: ["upper-basin-fill", "upper-basin-outline"] },
      { label: "Lower Basin", ids: ["lower-basin-fill", "lower-basin-outline"] },
      { label: "Rivers",      ids: ["rivers-line"] },
      { label: "Reservoirs",  ids: ["reservoirs-circle"] }
    ]

    layers.forEach(layer => {
      const row      = document.createElement("div")
      row.style.cssText = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-top:6px;"
      const checkbox = document.createElement("input")
      checkbox.type    = "checkbox"
      checkbox.checked = true
      checkbox.style.cursor = "pointer"
      const label      = document.createElement("label")
      label.textContent = layer.label
      label.style.cursor = "pointer"
      checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const vis = checkbox.checked ? "visible" : "none"
        layer.ids.forEach(id => map.setLayoutProperty(id, "visibility", vis))
      })
      row.appendChild(checkbox)
      row.appendChild(label)
      toggle.appendChild(row)
    })

    document.getElementById("basin-map").appendChild(toggle)

  }) // end map.on("load")
}

init_map()
</script>
```
